sections.name: File setup (part 1)
sections.title: Menu base parts and submenus
sections.what: Brings in the menu library and icons, then sets up the basic menu parts: the root, trigger, group, portal, sub menu and radio group. It also styles the sub menu trigger and the sub menu panel.
sections.why: Gives the app consistent drop down menus that the rest of the code can reuse. Reason for the sub menu styling is not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The sub menu panel class line is cut off in this packet, so the full styling could not be checked.

sections.name: File setup (part 2)
sections.title: Main menu panel, items and check items
sections.what: Styles the main menu panel with its shadow and animation, one menu item with hover and disabled looks, and a check box style item with a check mark when selected.
sections.why: Makes every menu look the same and gives users clear feedback when an item is selected or unavailable.
sections.watch_out: The main panel class line is cut off in this packet, so the full styling could not be checked.

sections.name: File setup (part 3)
sections.title: Radio items, labels, and dividers
sections.what: Defines three small menu parts: a radio option that shows a dot when chosen, a bold label line, and a thin divider line.
sections.why: Likely reason: standard menu parts reused by menus across the app.

sections.name: File setup (part 4)
sections.title: Shortcut text and export list
sections.what: Defines a small right-aligned text slot for keyboard shortcut hints, and lists every menu part other files can import from this file.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets other files import the menu parts they need from one place.
sections.watch_out: Renaming any name in the export list breaks every file that imports it.

summary: Shared building blocks for dropdown menus, including labels, dividers, radio options and shortcut text.
purpose: Gives every dropdown in the app the same look and behavior.
why: Likely reason: a standard menu kit reused across the app. Only part of the file was visible.
how: Wraps a menu library into named parts. The visible parts include radio items, labels, separators, a shortcut text part, and the export list. The first part of the file, which holds the menu, trigger, content and item parts, is not in the sample.
inputs: Props for each part, the children, and style options.
risks: Only the middle and end of the file were visible, so click behavior of menu items is not confirmed. Changes here affect every dropdown, including the profile switcher and the user menu.
debug: If a menu looks wrong, check the matching part in this file. If an import fails, check the export list at the end of the file.
